summary: Approved with warnings. Static review and unit tests pass, and the live cafeteria teleop command is syntactically/configurationally correct. Runtime Experimenter validation is still needed before user-facing use because live Unreal/Lumen brightness drift was not exercised.
work_completed: Reviewed Builder result packet and changed files for live realistic lighting, profile resolution, inverse-square and shadow fallbacks, orbit propagation, and tests.

Verified the exact Builder validation command parses under spear-env and resolves --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 to /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/cafeteria_500sqft_v2/Maps/cafeteria_500sqft_v2 with realistic_live_flashlight, inverse-square enabled, fixed exposure, local-exposure suppression, Lumen GI/reflection retention, and 3.0s warmup.

findings.message: Runtime Experimenter validation is needed before user use. The implementation statically addresses the suspected drift path via launch/runtime local-exposure suppression and warmup (examples/flashlight/run.py:32-47, examples/flashlight/run.py:461-507, examples/flashlight/run.py:624-642), but no Unreal live session was run to confirm Lumen/reflection history convergence or visible brightness stability.

Inherited source-radius fallback still uses dynamic property probing via hasattr/getattr in examples/flashlight/run.py:261-281 and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py:533-553. The new inverse-square and shadow/contact-shadow fallbacks avoid that pattern by using method attempts plus set_editor_property/__dict__ checks (examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.py:222-318), so the requested inverse-square path looks safe, but a future Unreal proxy lacking SetSourceRadius/SetSoftSourceRadius could still hit the older resolveProperty risk.

Pass recommendation for the live cafeteria teleop command: examples/flashlight/run.py now defines cafeteria_500sqft_v2 (examples/flashlight/run.py:54-60), accepts --live-lighting-mode realistic and --startup-warmup-seconds (examples/flashlight/run.py:83-139), and build_config maps the alias into GAME_DEFAULT_MAP (examples/flashlight/run.py:410-423). The exact Builder command parsed and produced the intended config under spear-env.

Realistic mode preserves material/Lumen behavior rather than reusing validation render settings. REALISTIC_LIVE_RENDERER_ENGINE_INI enables DynamicGlobalIlluminationMethod, ReflectionMethod, Lumen diffuse indirect, and Lumen reflections (examples/flashlight/run.py:42-47), and runtime commands keep GI/reflection/material/specular show flags enabled (examples/flashlight/run.py:481-494).

Default behavior remains broadly compatible: live mode defaults to default and warmup defaults to 0.0 unless realistic mode is selected (examples/flashlight/run.py:83-139), and the default flashlight profile remains real_handheld_16in_16in while the new realistic_live_flashlight profile is opt-in (examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.json:1-24).

Tests cover the main change surfaces: realistic warmup default/override (tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:519-530), profile inverse-square resolution (tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:532-559), inverse-square method/property fallback (tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:620-651), warmup frame sequencing (tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:738-782), runtime local-exposure/Lumen commands (tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:784-803), and realistic build_config INI output (tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py:1567-1592).

follow_up_recommendations: Run Experimenter/live validation with: cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/spear && conda activate spear-env && python examples/flashlight/run.py --map cafeteria_500sqft_v2 --live-lighting-mode realistic --flashlight-profile realistic_live_flashlight --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0005 --movement-speed 600 --disable-auto-exposure --startup-warmup-seconds 3

During validation, confirm logs show local exposure commands applied, realistic live renderer retention true, inverse-square applied or safely reported false without crash, and no visible brightness drift after the warmup gate opens.
Consider replacing the older source-radius reflected fallback with the safer flashlight_profiles.try_set_reflected_property pattern in a follow-up cleanup.
memory_worthy: Static review approved the realistic live flashlight implementation and cafeteria command, but live Experimenter validation is required before user-facing use to confirm Unreal/Lumen brightness stability.
